rules.source: Published static room_maps.json contains exact annotated rooms and generated PNG paths. building_img_rules.json identifies overview images only.
rules.normalization: Trim, normalize full-width input with NFKC, and uppercase room codes. Accept ASCII letters, digits and separating hyphens, at most 64 input characters.
rules.coverage: highlighted means a verified room annotation; overview means only a matching floor/building image and does not assert room existence; unavailable means no map. Unmapped rooms are not guessed.
rules.public: Lookup is public and does not disclose personal schedules.
rules.calendar: Course and exam iCalendar events attach public image URLs, preferring highlighted room maps. Every mapped exam room contributes an attachment, deduplicated by URL. Descriptions include room-labeled map links. Missing maps never suppress events.
rules.web: Room labels support lazy hover/focus preview and click/tap expansion, with keyboard access and full-size image viewing.
rules.bot: Explicit room queries return a map and a short description. Do not attach every room map to ordinary timetable replies. Resolve ambiguous class references before querying a map.
